trends.name: Iran Cease-Fire & Strait of Hormuz Blockade
trends.summary: No oil tankers have passed through the Strait of Hormuz since the cease-fire was struck Tuesday, with only dry bulk carriers moving through. Trump warned military will remain near Iran until a 'real agreement' is reached, escalating geopolitical tensions. This directly threatens global oil supply and prices.

trends.name: Oil Market Volatility & Pricing Pressure
trends.summary: Oil prices have risen to nearly $100/barrel on Iran cease-fire fragility but remain below $100 amid supply uncertainty. Family offices and hedge funds have made significant gains from recent oil rallies after capital redeployment. Shipping data shows critical supply concerns are real, not speculative.

trends.name: AI Infrastructure Investment Surge
trends.summary: Meta commits an additional $21 billion to CoreWeave for AI infrastructure as capital expenditure on AI accelerates dramatically. OpenAI halts UK Stargate project amid regulatory and energy price concerns, signaling infrastructure bottlenecks. AI capex competition intensifying between tech giants despite profitability questions.

trends.name: AI Monetization & Software vs. Semiconductors Trade
trends.summary: Meta's new AI model launches but profitability remains uncertain, reflecting broader investor concerns about ROI on massive AI investments. The 'AI eats software' trade continues gaining momentum with software down ~840bps in a single day—the largest drawdown in 10+ years. Broadcom's AI dominance being undervalued as semis outperform software.

trends.name: US Economic Data Beating Expectations
trends.summary: The US Economic Surprise Index reached 0.338, the highest level since October 2023, indicating consistent beats versus expectations. Data has climbed +0.74 points since July 2025, signaling stronger-than-expected economic resilience. This could support equity valuations and delay rate cut expectations.

trends.name: GLP-1 Drug Adoption Reshaping Consumer Behavior
trends.summary: Eli Lilly's Foundayo (Orforglipron), a new oral GLP-1 pill, is now available in the US, expanding market reach beyond injectables. Millions adopting GLP-1s are turning to retailers to refresh wardrobes as weight loss accelerates, creating new consumer spending patterns. This shifts demand across apparel, food, and healthcare sectors.

trends.name: Commodity Food Price Deflation & Volatility
trends.summary: Beef prices hit record highs while wholesale egg prices fall to record lows when adjusted for wages, signaling extreme commodity volatility and supply chain stress. A 'super El Niño' event poses fresh risks to global food costs. Conagra and food producers face margin compression from input price chaos.

trends.name: Alibaba's Anonymous AI Video Model Launch
trends.summary: Alibaba quietly launches a new AI video model without official attribution, suggesting competitive AI arms race in Asia and potential regulatory sensitivity. This signals accelerating AI competition beyond US tech giants and geopolitical concerns around AI technology distribution.

trends.name: Earnings Boom Emerging Despite Market Skepticism
trends.summary: Analysts expect significant earnings growth ahead that could 'blindside stock-market bears,' supported by strong economic data beats and resilient corporate spending. Combined with improving economic surprise metrics, this creates upside risk to equity valuations in 2026.

trends.name: Private Equity & Credit Market Regulatory Shift
trends.summary: Private equity's favored insurance trades face upcoming UK regulatory curbs, signaling tighter compliance requirements on alternative asset strategies. This could constrain PE returns and force reallocation of capital into more regulated structures.

trends.name: Dollar Weakness Threat to US Equities
trends.summary: Weak dollar emerges as a real threat to US stock market performance, potentially offsetting earnings growth and creating currency headwinds for multinational corporations. This is particularly concerning given rising geopolitical tensions and capital flows.

trends.name: Tax Deadline & Personal Finance Planning
trends.summary: Tax filing deadline approaches with $350 penalties for procrastination, triggering broader personal finance planning discussions among investors in their 60s-70s regarding retirement, estate planning, and charitable giving strategies. This reflects demographic shift in investor base.
